title: ROV image shows a straight wall on the anomaly

tellings.quote: I mean I would say that's I must be at least 30 m 30 m at least. 60 m the whole thing.

plain: In 2025, pictures taken by a remotely operated underwater vehicle are said to show a long, straight wall on the Baltic Sea anomaly, an oddly shaped object lying on the floor of the Baltic Sea. A treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, who says he saw it for himself, tells Michels the wall must be "at least 30 m" long and the whole object about "60 m". A wall that straight would suggest something built, not natural rock.
